## Appearance

Nell is a slight, slender-framed individual with a straight-backed figure who stands an inch taller than [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). Her sharp, bright face features a small white complexion, a small pointed chin, rose-tinted cheeks, and a quantity of freckles, including seven on her nose. She has large, star-like gray eyes and a slender, alabaster neck. Her hair, which is styled in long red braids or worn unplaited, is fiery crimson and ginger, though it has also become green.

## Personality

Characterized by an unusually vivid imagination and a tendency to drift into reveries, this girl displays a passionate, theatrical nature alongside an impetuous and talkative demeanor. She is unselfish, intelligent, and compliant, yet she can also be stubborn, harbor animosity, and exhibit a swift temper, overly careless tendencies, and a susceptibility to disappointment. Deeply fond of nature, people, children, and the color pink, she aspires to spark happiness, bring beauty into the world, and learn how to best assist herself and others. academically and creatively, she is a fast runner skilled at writing essays, stories, poetry, and creative garden idylls, as well as baking cakes and managing youngsters, though she notably lacks general cooking ability. driven by strong ambitions, her goals include staying at her current home to provide care, qualifying for advanced entrance exams to make a beloved figure proud, becoming a teacher, securing a scholarship in English, and excelling in her studies, in which she surpasses her peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P18](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P20](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VII. ## History

Born in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), to high school teacher parents, Nell Harcourt was orphaned as a child and spent time in an asylum before being taken in by [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). Although initially sent by mistake, Nell was kept by the pair, quickly forming a close bond with her best friend [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) and navigating various childhood mishaps, including accidentally dying her hair green and injuring her ankle. Encouraged by her teacher Miss Agnes [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), she excelled academically and tied for first place on the island in the Regent's entrance examinations. Following Obed's unexpected death and Thirza's declining eyesight, Nell briefly gave up a college scholarship to stay home and teach locally at the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school, where she reconciled her past rivalries with [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). Nell later resumed her studies by enrolling at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), forming deep friendships with [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) and [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) while renting a home called Tabby's Place. During her college years, she began writing and publishing short stories, managed multiple unwanted marriage proposals from suitors like [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) and [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md), and rejected an initial romantic advance from Hugh. Upon graduating, Nell turned down a marriage proposal from [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) after realizing she did not love him. Returning to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Nell eventually reunited with Hugh when he confessed his enduring love for her in [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Wren's abandoned garden, and she joyfully accepted his proposal.

## Quotes

> "If you were a parentless child who arrived at a spot expected to be your home, only to discover you were undesired for not being a male, you would weep as well. Oh, my life has never known a more calamitous event!"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "yet, oh, I beg you to address me as Lucinda. What name you use for me cannot be of great importance to you if my stay is to be merely brief, can it? Besides, Nell is a name so lacking in romance."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why failed you to inform me at the depot that I was unwanted and abandon me at that place? Had I not observed the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters, this would be less difficult."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She acquired Lily Jones for her own. Lily has reached just five years of age and is extremely beautiful, possessing nut-brown hair. Were I extremely beautiful with nut-brown hair, would you retain me?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "In what way is it possible for you to term the night good, given your awareness that it has to be the most terrible one I have ever experienced?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P49](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

[Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) initially antagonized Nell by mocking her plain appearance and red hair, provoking an explosive temper outburst from the young girl [S1]. However, after Nell delivered a dramatic apology, [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) forgave her and offered advice on managing Nell's temper [S2, S5, S6]. Their early enmity was resolved, and [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) eventually grew to compliment Nell's grace and development over time [R1, S14].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-lavinia--nell-harcourt.md)

[Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) first encountered Nell when the girl inadvertently jumped onto her bed during a late-night prank [S7]. A strong friendship developed between them, leading [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) to host Nell in town for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and other local entertainments [R2, S8, S9].

### Carrow

Carrow maintained a complex relationship with Nell at school, competing academically for top marks while engaging in intense personal conflict [R4, R6]. Although Nell once despised him and rejected his efforts to make amends after an incident, he later saved her and eventually settled into the role of a concerned friend [R5, R6, R7]. During a visit to Tabby's Place, Nell hosted his family, connecting warmly with his sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) despite several awkward mishaps [S12].

### [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hugh-carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) initially antagonized Nell by teasing her about her red hair, provoking her to smash her slate over his head and refuse to speak to him [R15, S31, S32]. Over time, their hostility shifted into academic competition and then a close friendship through the B.V.I.S., culminating in Hugh rescuing her in a dory [R12, R14, R16]. Hugh became infatuated with Nell and eventually proposed to her, but she rejected his romantic advances to preserve their friendship, causing significant emotional tension between them [R13, S149, S159]. While rumors circulated that they might marry or that he was engaged to someone else, these were unconfirmed claims [R17, S150, S159].

### [Thora](../character/thora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thora.md)

[Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet was Nell's landlady and companion while Nell stayed at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road) [R63, S173, S174]. Nell supported [Thora](../character/thora.md) through her romantic struggles with [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), even persuading her to stand up to him before celebrating their ultimate engagement [S175, S176].
